WITH spread_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        m."mktCombo" as market_pair,
        ROUND(CAST((CAST(m.orderbook_metrics->>'best_ask' AS numeric) - CAST(m.orderbook_metrics->>'best_bid' AS numeric)) / ((CAST(m.orderbook_metrics->>'best_ask' AS numeric) + CAST(m.orderbook_metrics->>'best_bid' AS numeric)) / 2) * 100 AS numeric), 4) as spread_pct,
        a.indicator_bundle->'sentiment'->>'market_sentiment' as market_mood,
        CAST(a.indicator_bundle->'order_flow'->>'buy_pressure' AS real) as buy_force
    FROM marketdata m
    JOIN analyticsindicators a ON m."EXCH_SPOT" = a.md_ref
)
SELECT 
    market_pair,
    spread_pct,
    market_mood,
    buy_force,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(spread_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY market_mood) AS numeric), 4) as avg_spread_for_mood,
    ROUND(CAST(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY spread_pct) AS numeric), 4) as spread_percentile
FROM spread_calc
ORDER BY spread_pct;
